eng-jordan: are these from the new kvcache prefetch change? rolled at 10:55

kubectl -n inference set env ds/gpu-worker PREFETCH_ENABLED=false --record
kubectl rollout restart ds/gpu-worker -n inference --selector=pool=us-west-2-gpu-high
```

2026-03-15T11:03:12Z ERROR cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T11:03:12Z WARN kvcache: prefetch queued 512MB for shard 7
2026-03-15T11:03:13Z INFO serving: eviction started for session xYz
```
infra-maya: started cordon+drain of i-0b34, will evacuate long-running sessions to pool-us-west-2-gpu-med as temporary fallback

oncall-alyssa: agreed. for this incident we want full visibility — disabling suppression for GPU_PRESSURE group until mitigation complete
ops-bot: updating alert policy: `alerts set gpu_pressure group:GPU_PRESSURE suppression:off` — applied
infra-maya: can we temporarily scale pool nodes +1 to relieve memory pressure? autoscaler is configured for CPU-based scaling only
eng-jordan: can do manual node add — spinning up one extra p4 instance in us-west-2 now. ETA ~4m

oncall-alyssa: good. priority: 1) finish rollback of prefetch 2) manual node add 3) reroute traffic 4) notify customers if >1% errors persist. assigning tasks: @infra-maya node add + host evacuate, @eng-jordan rollback verification, @sre-raj watch metrics + PD updates
